items.content:
The Chemex filter is thicker, so it strips more oil and you get a cleaner,
flatter cup. The V60's cone and spiral ribs let it drain faster and keep
more body.

I thought I wanted clean. I want body. Six months of making the wrong
thing carefully.

summary: Chemex strips oil for a cleaner cup; V60 keeps body, and body wins
title: V60 vs Chemex, finally settled (for me)
